input.content:
# Router rule proposal · week of Oct 19

The five most expensive hops are all Ultra or long Super hops; four of them are the orchestrator's late turns (approval and final judgment).

## Proposed rules (src/runtime/router-rules.json)

| rule | why | expected effect |
|---|---|---|
| orchestrator "final judgment" turns: ceiling Super | a one-paragraph summary does not need Ultra | about 9 % of weekly spend |
| researcher "reporting" turns with no tool call: Nano | a short sourced summary | about 3 % |

## Proof

`pnpm eval:ab --cheap` ran on the six cheap goldens: see the Analyst's output in the Agent I/O tab. The router already saves spend on those; the two proposed rules are not in it yet, so the saving above is an estimate.
